svg.text: Complete Normalized Relational Architecture | 15 Tables, CHECK Constraints & Snapshot Pricing Rates

g.text: 5 DYNAMIC POSTGRESQL VIEWS (AUTOMATED STATE DERIVATION & FINANCIAL INTEGRITY)
Computes worker 'Assigned' vs 'Available' by dynamically checking if CURRENT_DATE falls in active task window.
Computes machinery 'In Use' vs 'Available' dynamically from ongoing equipment_assignments.
Calculates true duration-weighted completion percentage: Σ(pct * duration_days) / Σ(duration_days).
Live aggregation of purchase line items calculating total PO value via SUM(quantity * unit_price).
Consolidates 4 cost streams via UNION ALL: Materials (Delivered POs), Labour (task_workers locked rates),
Equipment (equipment_assignments locked rates), and Direct Expenses into an immutable audit ledger.
